messages:
Sasha K: Quick postmortem follow-up from the outage with CloudAuth + ModelRegistry caches. Postmortem doc: https://redwood/doc/pm/376123 — root cause: auth token cache thrash + model-registry auth calls hitting rate limits in us-west-2. Need owners for remediation items below. TL;DR: cross-region fallback cache, scoped token retry with jitter, mock registry fallback for read-only requests, and post-deploy runbook.

Matt R: I can own cross-region cache design and rollout. ETA: design doc by EOD Thu, rollout plan next week. Will validate with infra.

Priya S: I'll take the SDK token retry/backoff work. Plan: bump retries to 5 with exp jitter, add short-circuit for known idempotent flows, and telemetry hooks. PR draft by Tue.

Tim O: I'll own the mock model-registry fallback (read-only inference). Need privacy sign-off for cached responses. Targeting Wed for initial PR.

Carla L: I'll own the post-deploy runbook and alerting + SLA verification. Will add alerts: auth token error rate > 0.5% over 5m, model-registry 429s > 0.2% over 5m. Runbook will include steps to flip fallback and run a smoke inference.

Sasha K: @Matt R @Priya S @Tim O please add yourselves to the action tracker and set labels 'priority:high' and 'sprint:next' — https://redwood/gtm/actions/376123. We need clear owners and due dates.

Matt R: Added myself to action-1 (cross-region cache). Link: https://redwood/gtm/actions/376123#action-1. I'll coordinate with eng-infra for replication primitives.

Priya S: Added action-2, created PR #4821 as a draft with tests for transient 401/429 paths.

OpsBot: Incident follow-up task created and assigned. Due dates: Matt R - 2026-04-10, Priya S - 2026-04-06, Tim O - 2026-04-07, Carla L - 2026-04-08. Reminder set for 3 days before each due date.

Tim O: Quick design question — for cross-region cache, prefer active-passive to start to avoid consistency churn. Thoughts?

Matt R: Active-passive makes sense as a first iteration. We'll add async replication and a tombstone marker for quick invalidation. Documenting now.

Carla L: For the runbook, playbook entries to include: (1) Fail-open behavior -> switch inference paths to fallback model-registry read-only; (2) Token service degraded -> rotate cached short-lived tokens and enable emergency service-account path; (3) Escalation matrix + comm templates.

Sasha K: Also scheduling a 30m follow-up retro Thu 10am PT to verify progress and test the runbook. @everyone please RSVP in the event.

Priya S: RSVP'd. I'll also push a small harness to simulate token thrashing so we can run a dry-run in staging.

Matt R: I'll run a DR dry-run in staging to simulate us-west-2 auth disruption and validate fallback. Will need eng-infra help to simulate region-level routing.

Carla L: I'll post the runbook draft to the tracker once Matt's dry-run is scheduled, and will coordinate smoke-test criteria.

Sasha K: Great. Post any blockers here. Thanks all.
